name: smwmusic-mega-man-x-swearing-loyalty-to-the-mines-armored-armadillo-remix
title: Mega Man X - Swearing Loyalty to the Mines ⛏️ ~ Armored Armadillo (Remix)
description:
❝ There's nothing Maverick about following orders. We're not in the wrong, X. ❞
ㅤ- Armored Armadillo, Mega Man Maverick Hunter X (2005)

Did an arrangement of Armored Armadillo's Stage from Mega Man X. It's been nearly four years since I last touched a song from PEAK FICTION, so I decided it's time to do it again!! Wanted to try basing this off all the official renditions (minus the DOS version 'cuz that one sucks).

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. A Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. G# Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
